# SOP template

!!! warning "Draft template — for editorial review"
    This outline is not an executable or approved procedure. Scientific steps, operating conditions and acceptance criteria must be developed for the specific activity and reviewed by the responsible contributors. Completing this template does not establish approval.

## How to use this template

Copy this outline into a separate document for one repeatable activity. Replace each `[TODO: ...]` with activity-specific information. Where a section does not apply, state “Not applicable” and explain why. Keep unresolved items visible for review.

A [validation protocol](validation-protocol-template.md) describes the study and its evaluation plan. An SOP describes how to carry out an activity consistently within that plan. Link related documents by identifier and version so the applicable procedure can be traced.

Keep patient identifiers, credentials and individual patient records out of the public documentation. Reference the appropriate controlled records instead.
